notes:
Removes Fly Pilot from the shipped build.

1.8.7 shipped it as an experimental toggle before it was ready. It was also inert: the call that reads its config never made it into the DLL, so the switch wrote a file nothing consumed. Every shipped file is back to its pre-1.8.7 state, and the rebuilt game-server DLL differs from the one in 1.8.1 only by its build timestamp and checksum.

Everything from 1.8.2 to 1.8.6 is unchanged and still included, so if you are coming from 1.8.1 you still get the whole bumper chain:
- The intro bumper draws through the game's own media texture instead of a guessed vtable.
- The bumper stays hidden until Battle Royale, and has sound.
- The lobby music waits for the bumper instead of talking over it.
- All music stops for the bumper, by sound class.
- One soundtrack after the bumper, not two.

Known issue, not fixed by this update: hosting on 7.40 aborts with "Unable to find ProcessEventAddress". That is a signature in the game-server DLL that misses on this build. It is not new and not caused by 1.8.7 - the 1.8.1 DLL fails identically - and it only shows up when your machine is elected host.
